purpose: Page when the scheduled seismograph cron never fires. The app cannot see a cron that never calls it.

signal.description: The scheduled handler would POST once, after a completed claim, to the URL in FAULTLINE_DEAD_MAN_ALERT_URL. That env var is unset. Nothing in start-production.sh or the scheduler reads this file.

pageWhen: No success ping arrives by 16:50 America/New_York on an NYSE session day.
activation: Owner creates the external monitor and sets the URL. This repository does not activate it.
